messages:
maria: Quick FYI — I'm prototyping an `X-Embed-Estimated-Units` response header + matching preflight so the Console shows per-request cost estimates before issuing. Want to sync on rollout.

devon: :eyes: interesting. where is estimate computed? runtime or ingress?

maria: runtime exposes an estimator that uses dims+tokens+quant profile. ingress preflight will call it for UI only — no billing plumbing yet.

kevin: okay — two immediate concerns: (1) estimator divergence from final billed units, (2) telemetry cardinality for console traces.

sarah: agree. we should mark it "estimate" in the UI and include `estimator_version` in traces.

henry: telemetry plan: emit `embed.estimate.value`, `embed.estimate.version`, `embed.request.dims`, `embed.request.count` as dtypes. sample rate 10% by default.

maria: proposed rollout playbook:
1) opt-in flag `embed_estimator_ui` (canary tenants)
2) expose header in preflight: `X-Embed-Estimated-Units: 123`
3) Console shows "est. units" with tooltip linking to docs
4) collect traces + diff vs billed for canary
5) if drift <5% after 24h, enable wider

kevin: re payload limits: estimator should cap on overly-large dims; return `X-Embed-Estimate-Note: clipped` when we clip for safety.

devon: code snippet for ingress preflight:
```
GET /v1/embeddings/preflight
Headers: {
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
  "X-Client-Id": "acme",
}
Response:
{
  "estimated_units": 124,
  "estimator_version": "v1.3",
  "note": "clipped"
}
```

sarah: UX: show both est units and a subtle warning if request will be split across shards. UX copy: "Estimated units (may split across requests)".

ingress-bot: preflight ping — sample tenant 'canary-42' returned estimate 87 (estimator v1.3) at 3123456821

maria: open Qs: where to store estimator metrics? TSDB? traces? both? henry?

henry: both. counters in TSDB for aggregates, traces for per-request diffs. make sure we don't include raw user text in traces.

maria: agreed, strip PII. I'll draft the PR for ingress + console changes. tagging @devon @kevin for review. :100:

kevin: cool. put e2e test simulating dimensionality skew. last message: let's start canary tomorrow during low traffic window.

devon: 👍

sarah: :rocket:
